metadata.title: Sunbo Collective | Wasilat Atilade
metadata.description: I support digital campaigns, social media content and audience engagement for Sunbo Collective. The selected campaign imagery brings together the brand’s apparel, visual identity and community-facing content.

metadata.title: Final Year Week ’26 | Wasilat Atilade
metadata.description: I led a 22-member committee to deliver a five-day faculty-wide celebration for more than 1,000 final-year students across SOSSA and COMMSA. From the first planning meeting to the final setup, my work connected the people, logistics and decisions behind the experience.

metadata.title: NSASA Presidency | Wasilat Atilade
metadata.description: As NSASA President, I represented a community of approximately 800 students and coordinated 10 executive leads within an 11-member team. My focus was keeping people aligned, responding to student needs and delivering the association’s major activities throughout the tenure.

metadata.title: Sign-Out After Party | Wasilat Atilade
metadata.description: I worked alongside the Faculty Social Secretary to plan and promote a faculty sign-out after-party for graduating students. My contribution centred on pre-event coordination, raising awareness and getting students interested in attending.

metadata.title: Explore 7.0 — Annual Sociology Conference | Wasilat Atilade
metadata.description: I led the annual Sociology conference from planning through execution, coordinating a 10-person team over a year. The theme, “People Power and the Future: Navigating Life in a Changing Society”, anchored a conference that welcomed more than 500 attendees.
